Step-18.Description: Deletes temporary packet persona and template files from disk

Step-1.Description: Loads prerequisite center machine and user data from stored index and stores output for later steps

Step-4.Description: Reads resident demographic and biometric data from persona file and stores output for later steps

Step-13.Description: Submits credential issuance request for resident UIN and stores output for later steps

Step-14.Description: Checks credential request processing status in credential service
Step-14.Input Parameters: request Id

Step-15.Description: Validates notification delivery for resident email or SMS
Step-15.Input Parameters: notification type and email or phone and email1

Step-16.Description: Downloads printable UIN card or credential artifact for resident
Step-16.Input Parameters: request Id

Step-17.Description: Updates demographic or biometric fields inside persona file

Step-18.Description: Updates persona file with generated UIN for follow up flows

Step-19.Description: Creates UPDATE process packet template from persona and stores output for later steps

Step-20.Description: Builds and uploads registration packet without preregistration flow and stores output for later steps

Step-21.Description: Checks RID packet status is PROCESSED in registration processor

Step-22.Description: Fetches issued UIN for the resident using RID and stores output for later steps
Step-22.Input Parameters: RID

Step-23.Description: Validates notification delivery for resident email or SMS
Step-23.Input Parameters: notification type and email or phone and email1

Step-24.Description: Waits UIN WAIT TIME seconds for backend jobs to complete
Step-24.Input Parameters: NA

Step-25.Description: Generates virtual ID for resident UIN and stores output for later steps

Step-26.Description: Validates notification delivery for resident email or SMS
